title: Operator Autopilot Workbench
goal: Add an operator workbench for ai_loop runs that shows the current goal, evidence hypotheses, next-best actions, RUN/SKIP/WAIT/APPROVAL state, approval gates, blockers, coverage truth, and safe override controls in one live surface.
scope: React v2 Mission Control and AI-loop operator UX.
generation_reason: Operators need to see what the AI is doing, why it is doing it, what is blocked, and what needs approval without reading logs or guessing from task lists.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: The workbench is visible only for run_mode === 'ai_loop' and must not replace manual wizard or fixed-chain Mission Control.

success_criteria: Mission Control selects the AI workbench layout only for ai_loop runs.
The workbench shows evidence-linked hypotheses, next action, blocker, approval, and coverage truth cards from backend data.
Approve/reject/continue controls use existing approval/proposal endpoints and never dispatch outside registered flows.

acceptance_criteria: ai_loop runs show the autopilot workbench.
manual and fixed-chain runs keep their existing Mission Control layout.
UI text uses controlled proof, canary evidence, and session exposure risk language where applicable.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
